parsed.explanation: Combined regime: the national border and custody layers dominate. Passport sex-marker restrictions are in force (upheld November 2025), and the entry cable directs refusal on any document discrepancy, with a possible lifetime fraud ineligibility finding. Federal immigration custody has documented forced labour, beatings and sexual abuse of trans men. The state layer adds no operative bathroom or facility ban for visitors, and the facility bill is not law. Two cities protect restroom use. Remedies are partial and litigation is pending. Hostile state ID and minors'-care rules are resident- or minor-facing and lower the score mainly for families. Score sits in the Elevated band, below the 0.45 anchors for lack of the documented custody harm.

entry_documents.exposure: Passports issued only as M or F by birth sex; new applications refused on discrepancy; passports confiscated or blocked, leaving some stranded; fraud-ground lifetime ineligibility possible.
entry_documents.protection: Existing X passports valid to expiry; policy under legal challenge; the ban is not yet settled.
entry_documents.interaction: Federal document regime applies at every border crossing regardless of the state; state ID rules do not reach visitors' home passports.

investigation_detention_custody.exposure: Immigration custody: documented forced labour, beatings, solitary confinement and severe sexual abuse of trans men; federal corrections adopted conversion-therapy-style policies from 2026; reporting of trans prisoners stopped.
investigation_detention_custody.protection: Not documented for visitors in custody; a national reversal of a prior LGBTQ prison policy is documented.
investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Federal custody applies irrespective of state rules; state prison housing bill is not law.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: No operative state bathroom or facility ban for visitors as of April 2026; facility bill passed upper chamber only; state trespass-arrest law elsewhere in the dossier is not shown to govern this state.
federal_state_facilities.protection: Operative state law places no restriction on restroom use matching gender identity; two cities protect it by ordinance; proposals to criminalise died in committee since 2021.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Federal facility rules and national funding conditions still reach state institutions; the state layer is protective on facilities only.

care_services.exposure: Gender-affirming care for under-18s banned; a visitor under 18 cannot obtain it; federal subpoenas for minors' records and proposed insurance bars add exposure.
care_services.protection: Adult care not documented either way; the dossier does not show adult access restrictions.
care_services.interaction: Care refusal at state level compounds federal records-subpoena exposure for minors.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: National counterterrorism strategy names 'radically pro-transgender' groups as targets; executive orders direct prosecutions of teachers; official hostility to advocacy documented.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Counterterrorism statement disclaims targeting mere disagreement; several national orders are enjoined.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: National threat-framing sits above the state; state legislature frames sex by birth biology.

minors_guardians.exposure: Minor cannot access care; pending school-bathroom bill would bar trans students; K-3 parental-notification law; federal school-prosecution directive; national subpoenas of minors' records.
minors_guardians.protection: Minor's school bathroom use protected by a federal injunction (August 2023) while litigation continues; local ordinances in two cities.
minors_guardians.interaction: A minor travelling with a guardian faces document and care exposure; a guardian faces parental-notification and records exposure.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: No trans-specific violence or police targeting documented in this state. National hate-crime statute applies; 2019 state aggravator covers gender identity; no enforcement data.
street_violence_police_response.protection: Hate-crime enhancement since 2019; local anti-discrimination ordinances in several counties and cities; national employment protection.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Local protections are strongest in larger cities; statewide coverage is thinner.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Passport and ID policies challenged but unresolved; no enforcement data on bias aggravators; state-level climate ranked among the most restrictive by one February 2026 assessment.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Courts have enjoined several national orders and upheld a bathroom injunction; ordinances offer recourse locally.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Recourse operates unevenly across federal and state layers; visitor remedies at the border are unclear.

anchor_checks.comparison: Anchor exclusion by a register with no effective appeal is harsher than this case, which has no state exclusion mechanism and no register. This case is similar only for border document refusal and possible lifetime ineligibility.

Anchor universal biometric checks with detention and denial of care are similar to this case's universal document refusal. This case adds documented federal custody sexual abuse, which lowers it, but has no state-level checks or public-order detention, which raises it.

Anchor birth-sex housing and cross-dressing arrests are harsher than this case, which has no operative state facility ban or state arrest route. The federal custody harm is comparable, so this case scores above 0.25.

parsed.synthesis: A traveller meets a federal document and border regime that refuses marker discrepancies and can impose lifetime fraud ineligibility, and any custody the traveller enters carries documented sexual abuse and forced-labour harm. The state layer is protective on bathrooms: no operative ban, no criminal route, and local ordinances. Its ID ban and pending facility bill mostly reach residents, though a pending facility bill would raise exposure if enacted. Minors cannot obtain care here and face federal records exposure. The state's own climate and the federal threat framing keep the rating in the Elevated band rather than Reduced.
